name: Notifications
why: What raises an alert and how fast you clear it
ideal: Only a wait, an error or a reply raises an alert, and the oldest wait clears within a day.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Event
steps.rule: Only a wait, an error or a reply is an event that can alert.

steps.name: Sort
steps.rule: The default set of three events stays on; one per finished turn stays off.

steps.name: Alert
steps.rule: An alert shows unless you are already viewing the project.

steps.name: You act
steps.rule: A thread in Waiting on you gets your answer within a day.

steps.name: Clear
steps.rule: The thread leaves Waiting on you once you answer.
